execution.backtest.description: Run pipeline over historical data, compute risk-adjusted metrics

execution.paper.description: Submit one paper/testnet order. Requires approved RiskCheck.

execution.live.description: Submit one live order to Binance. Requires double confirmation + approved RiskCheck.
preconditions: API key has NO withdrawal permission
execution.live.side_effects: Real order on Binance, writes to orders table

execution.status.description: Open positions + realized and unrealized P&L

execution.kill.description: Kill switch: close all positions + pause pipeline
execution.kill.side_effects: Closes positions, pauses Cloud Scheduler, sets kill_switch=true in DB
